recentItems.title: Zero-tariff policy allows more Egyptian strawberries to enter China
recentItems.description:
It may come as a surprise to a lot of people that Egypt is a top exporter of frozen strawberries. Now China is becoming a top buyer. Since May 1, 2026, China scrapped tariffs on imports from Egypt, lowering the cost of market access. Yasser Hakim and Chen Tong file this report from the two countries.

recentItems.title: The Heat: SCO Summit 2026 | What's on the agenda?
recentItems.description:
The Heat: SCO Summit 2026 | What's on the agenda?

A message of unity, peace, development and prosperity. The Shanghai Cooperation Organization is celebrating 25 years, but its focus is firmly on the future. 

As Chinese President Xi Jinping addressed the "SCO Plus" meeting in Kyrgyzstan's capital Bishkek, he called on the organization to shoulder the responsibility of the times and work together to advance a more just and equitable global governance system. #SCO #Bishkek #China #XiJinping #GlobalSouth #Multipolarity  #China #Russia #India

The #Heat host: Anand Naidoo 

Guests: 
Zoon Ahmed Khan is a research fellow at the Center for China and Globalization. 
Wang Huiyao is founder of the Center for China and Globalization and former counselor of China's State Council. 
Zorawar Daulet Singh is an author and strategic affairs expert.
Anton Fedyashin is a professor of history at American University.

recentItems.title: Beyond Borders Ep. 2 | North-South common ground: Wang Huiyao and John Quelch
recentItems.description:
In the age of artificial intelligence, rapid technological transformation poses profound questions for our shared future. While some industrialized nations in the Global North are pulling out of multilateral institutions, the international community faces the Kindleberger Trap: As established leaders retreat, who will step up to provide essential global public goods? At the same time, countries across the Global South are embracing open-source AI models to drive practical development in critical areas. As these new technologies emerge, frameworks like the Global Governance Initiative and inclusive platforms like the World Artificial Intelligence Cooperation Organization are vital to ensure these tools benefit all of humanity.

In this episode, Wang Huiyao, director of the Center for China and Globalization, sits down with John Quelch, executive vice chancellor of Duke Kunshan University in east China. How can different nations bridge their divides and build a resilient, cooperative system of global governance? Let's dive into the dialogue.

#AI #ChinaUS #AIArmsRace #TechCompetition #BeyondBorders
